moments.author: Joe Mixon
moments.why: A surprise return to the NFL—Mixon announced his comeback as he signs with the Seahawks’ practice squad, sparking huge buzz.

moments.author: Joe Mixon
moments.quote: Paraphrase: he reflected on a tough 18 months and leaned into faith, saying 'your breakthrough is coming.'
moments.why: Adds emotional depth to his comeback post and resonates strongly with fans on overcoming adversity.

moments.author: Mike Macdonald
moments.quote: Paraphrase: coach confirmed Mixon is going through the process to join the Seahawks’ practice squad.
moments.why: Official confirmation of Mixon’s signing makes this more than tweet buzz—it's NFL roster news.

moments.author: Dawn Staley
moments.quote: “If you only knew….or thought outside of your box…”
moments.why: Staley pushed back at media assumptions in a sharp reply that’s been widely shared.

moments.author: DHS (Department of Homeland Security)
moments.quote: Paraphrase: DHS used a Brian Dawkins meme in a viral post, leading Dawkins to respond that he did not give permission.
moments.why: A government social media post went viral for using an NFL legend’s image without consent, sparking debate.
